title: Nick Bostrom on What Happens if AI Solves All of Our Problems
snippet: The philosopher Nick Bostrom was one of the first thinkers who mapped out the existential risk of AI. In his 2014 book, Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies, he delved into various scenarios …
